_comment_logo: logo is the PNG fallback, favicon and default share image. logoLight and logoDark are optional: the approved transparent originals the header shows for light and dark appearance.
_comment_languages: Site chrome languages. A language listed here gets a full set of pages. Product and legal content declare their own languages separately, so a product may ship fewer languages than the site.
_comment_analytics: No analytics, no tracking, no external fonts or CDNs. Turning any of that on changes the privacy policy.
_comment_socials: Optional. Verified official accounts only, shown by platform name. One account is linked directly in the footer; two or more share one footer menu. Without this list, the youtube value above is used.
